recommendations.title: Optimize Storage Costs
recommendations.description: Consider using object storage services like Amazon S3, Azure Blob Storage, or Google Cloud Storage. Utilize features like lifecycle management, data compression, and tiered storage to reduce costs.
steps: Assess current storage usage and identify areas for optimization
Implement lifecycle management policies for data retention and deletion
Utilize data compression and tiered storage to reduce costs
Consider using a cloud storage gateway for on-premises data access

recommendations.title: Migrate to a Free Database Option
recommendations.description: Consider using a free database option like OpenSearch or a cloud-based managed database service like Amazon Aurora or Azure Database Services.
steps: Assess current database usage and identify areas for optimization
Migrate to a free database option or a cloud-based managed database service
Implement database scaling and performance optimization

recommendations.title: Implement Kubernetes Autoscaling
recommendations.description: Implement Kubernetes autoscaling to dynamically adjust compute resources based on workload demands.
steps: Deploy a Kubernetes cluster with autoscaling capabilities
Configure autoscaling policies for compute resources
Monitor and adjust autoscaling policies as needed

recommendations.title: Use a Free CDN Option
recommendations.description: Consider using a free CDN option like Cloudflare or a cloud-based CDN service like Amazon CloudFront or Azure CDN.
steps: Assess current CDN usage and identify areas for optimization
Migrate to a free CDN option or a cloud-based CDN service
Configure CDN caching and content delivery policies

recommendations.title: Implement Centralized Logging with ELK
recommendations.description: Implement a centralized logging solution like ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) to improve logging and monitoring capabilities.
steps: Deploy an ELK stack with Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana
Configure logging and monitoring policies for ELK
Monitor and adjust ELK policies as needed

recommendations.title: Use a Cloud-Based Monitoring Service
recommendations.description: Consider using a cloud-based monitoring service like Prometheus or a cloud-based monitoring platform like Datadog.
steps: Assess current monitoring usage and identify areas for optimization
Migrate to a cloud-based monitoring service or platform
